_comment: Release-asset layout of the prebuilt binaries this project downloads. The Xray core is NOT here — it is built from a pinned source archive (scripts/binary-versions.sh + scripts/build-xray.sh). Read by scripts/fetch-binaries.sh. URL = https://github.com/<repo>/releases/download/<TAG>/<file>, where TAG is the version_var value and {ver} expands to TAG without the leading 'v'. member is the binary's name inside the archive (a glob); archive 'raw' means the asset IS the binary. Only the Android arm64 module target is shipped; there is no desktop build.
